outside.says: The terms permit service suspension and token freezing for legal or discretionary compliance reasons. Stays in the terms; the Ethereum authorities were not read.
The interest may be reallocated among specific bars automatically on transfer, so no holder has a permanent bar serial.
Who may sue the custodian, at whose cost and under which contract stays in the terms and the custody agreement, which is not published.

verdict.summary: TG Commodities' terms and BDO's dated assurance can be said as T, status backed and an audited certification, and BDO publishes in its own name. The custodian is not named, so H has no signer, and the holder's real protection, a third-party-beneficiary claim against that custodian, cannot be said for holders as a class. The token is ERC-20 (and XAUt0 sits behind a lock contract), so the reader cannot read it, and insurance has no statement.
